Frequency once per day

Trigger A Signal-declared effect of yours fails or critically fails

Traits Paradise-Touched

The triggering effect succeeds instead, whatever the degree of its failure. You still take the force damage the failure would have dealt and still gain 1 Signal Drift, exactly as though it had failed — the cost lands on you and the effect lands on the world. What you get from a success is real, with no flat check, because it was declared Signal.
